info.title: server-streampack API
info.description: Bundled HTTP API for the server-streampack distribution of Streampack. Includes blog, authentication, and related site endpoints. Advisory version headers are supported: clients may send 'Accept-Version' and responses include 'Content-Version' and resolved 'Accept-Version'.

get.summary: Get a post by ID
get.description: Returns full post detail by its UUIDv7 identifier. Draft posts are only visible to their author and admins.

put.description: Updates an existing post's title, content, tags, and/or categories. Editing is admin-only. Edits re-render HTML from the updated markdown source. If a `summary` is provided, it is persisted as the post excerpt.

put.summary: Set a factoid's attribute, creating the factoid if it's new
put.description: Sets one attribute (the text, unless another is named) as chat's `selector=value` does, as the signed-in user. A locked factoid is refused.

200.description: Updated; the factoid as it now stands

400.description: No value, or an attribute that can't be set

403.description: Factoid changes aren't enabled for the web

delete.summary: Forget a factoid, or one of its attributes
delete.description: As chat's `forget selector` (or `forget selector.attribute`), as the signed-in user. A locked factoid is refused.

400.description: An attribute that can't be forgotten

403.description: Factoid changes aren't enabled for the web

404.description: No such factoid, or no such attribute on it

put.summary: Edit a comment within the edit window

403.description: Not authorized or edit window expired

400.description: Invalid request

put.description: `RATES` (worth writing about), `MIGHT` or `DULL`. Replaces any rating the item had; every change is kept in the rating history. The same rating again changes nothing.

400.description: No rating, or not RATES, MIGHT or DULL

delete.description: Kept in the rating history. An item with no rating is left as it is.

delete.summary: Delete a post (soft by default, hard with ?hard=true)

put.summary: Approve a draft post and set publication date

post.summary: Receive GitHub webhook deliveries for github.com repositories
post.description: Validates X-Hub-Signature-256, deduplicates deliveries, and fans out issues, pull_request, release, and completed workflow_run events.

400.description: Malformed payload or repository metadata

post.summary: Receive GitHub webhook deliveries for one registered GitHub instance
post.description: Same processing as the bare route, verified against repositories on the instance named by the path.

400.description: Malformed payload or repository metadata

post.summary: Record a UI-driven access of a stored RSS item

get.summary: List published posts
get.description: Returns a paginated list of posts that are approved, not deleted, and have a publishedAt date in the past. Authenticated users also see their own drafts interleaved in the results.

post.summary: Create a new blog post draft
post.description: Submits a new post as a DRAFT awaiting admin approval. Authentication is required unless anonymous submission is enabled (see GET /features for the anonymousSubmission flag). Authenticated users must have a verified email. If a `summary` is provided, it is persisted as the post excerpt. Otherwise an excerpt is derived heuristically. Includes honeypot and timing-based spam prevention - frontends should include the 'website' field as a CSS-hidden input (left empty) and set 'formLoadedAt' to Date.now() when the form renders.

400.description: Validation error (blank title, blank content, or unverified email)

401.description: Authentication required (when anonymous submission is disabled)

get.summary: Get threaded comments for a post

post.summary: Add a comment to a post

404.description: Post or parent comment not found

post.summary: Record a UI-driven access of a blog post
Suggest tags heuristically from unsaved draft content
post.description: Returns non-persistent tag suggestions using deterministic heuristics (no AI call). Available to all callers.

400.description: Invalid input

post.summary: Derive a summary from unsaved draft content
post.description: Returns a non-persistent summary generated from title + markdown content. Requires authentication. For an admin, with AI enabled, the model writes it in the site's editorial voice (source=ai); otherwise it is the heuristic excerpt (source=heuristic), the same text shape used for persisted excerpts.

400.description: Invalid input

post.summary: Find the factoids an unsaved draft mentions
post.description: Returns the factoids the draft's prose mentions (whole words, ignoring case; code and links skipped), each with its definition and whether the draft already links it, and the [[…]] links naming factoids that don't exist. Nothing is stored; no AI. Requires authentication.

200.description: Factoids mentioned, and links to factoids that don't exist

400.description: Invalid input

post.summary: Draft a factoid for a name, for its author to edit and save
post.description: Writes a draft (text, URLs, tags, see-also) in the knowledge base's style, with the line the bot would say and whether it fits. URLs are checked to answer, tags limited to those in use (one new at most), see-also to existing factoids. Nothing is stored: save with PUT /factoids/{selector}. Needs AI; signed-in readers only.

400.description: No name, or one too long

409.description: A factoid by that name exists

503.description: AI isn't configured, or the draft couldn't be written

post.summary: Refresh an expired JWT token using a refresh token cookie
Verify a one-time sign-in code

429.description: Too many attempts for this identity; try again shortly

post.summary: Request a one-time sign-in code

202.description: Accepted; a code is sent only when the identity resolves on the chosen channel

post.summary: Log out the current session

get.summary: The tag stoplist

post.summary: Stoplist a term
post.description: The term is dropped, silently, from every tag list written from now on. Tags already stored are left alone.

400.description: No term, a system tag, or an alias

delete.summary: Take a term off the stoplist

post.summary: Split a queued tag into its parts
post.description: For a missing comma: every post and factoid carrying the queued tag carries the parts instead, in one transaction, and the queued tag's row goes. The parts default to the entry's hint tags. The entry is marked SPLIT. With `dryRun=true` nothing changes: the answer is what the split would do.

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: true to preview: the answer is what the action would do, and nothing is changed

400.description: Fewer than two parts, or no parts and no hint to take them from

post.summary: Keep a queued tag as a real tag
post.description: The tag stays as it is; the entry is marked KEPT.

400.description: The entry was already decided

post.summary: Dismiss a queued tag
post.description: The tag stays as it is; the entry is marked DISMISSED.

400.description: The entry was already decided

post.summary: Alias a queued tag to an existing one
post.description: Every post and factoid carrying the queued tag is re-pointed to `tag`, in one transaction; the queued tag's own row goes, and it becomes an alias of `tag`. The entry is marked ALIASED. With `dryRun=true` nothing changes: the answer is what the alias would do, the posts and factoids it would re-point.

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: true to preview: the answer is what the action would do, and nothing is changed

400.description: The target isn't an existing tag, or is the same tag

get.summary: Every tag alias

post.summary: Make a tag an alias of another
post.description: `alias` becomes an alias of the existing tag `tag`. Any posts and factoids carrying `alias` are re-pointed to `tag` in one transaction, its row goes, and its own aliases move to `tag`. Writing or looking up `alias` then finds `tag`. With `dryRun=true` nothing changes: the answer is what the alias would do.

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: true to preview: the answer is what the action would do, and nothing is changed

400.description: No alias, a target that isn't a tag, a system tag, or the same tag

delete.description: Nothing is re-pointed back: what was merged stays merged, and the name is free to be a tag of its own again.

post.summary: Map a feed tag to an existing tag
post.description: `name` becomes an alias of the existing tag `tag` (as `POST /admin/tags/aliases` makes one, taken off the stoplist first if it was there), so feed entries carrying it carry `tag`, and so does anything written with it. Marked MAPPED.

400.description: The target isn't an existing tag, or is the feed tag itself

404.description: No feed has carried that tag

post.summary: Ignore a feed tag
post.description: `name` is stoplisted (its alias removed first if it had one): dropped from feed entries' tags, and from every tag list written from now on. Marked IGNORED.

400.description: No name given

404.description: No feed has carried that tag

post.summary: Create a feed tag as a tag now
post.description: `name` is created as a tag without waiting for the threshold, through the vocabulary's create rule: a doubtful one goes to the review queue, and the AI near-miss checks it, as for any new tag. Marked CREATED.

400.description: No name given

404.description: No feed has carried that tag

post.summary: Run a guess pass now
post.description: Guesses the items received in the lookback that have no guess yet, as the daily pass does, and answers what it did. Only while the guess is on (`RSS_RATING_MODEL_GUESS`).

409.description: The guess is off, or a pass is running already

post.summary: Import RSS feeds from an OPML or plain text upload
post.description: Accepts a multipart file field named `file`. OPML is parsed first; non-OPML files fall back to line-by-line URL extraction.

post.summary: Attach or replace a post's version
post.description: Uploads a post's recording (`kind` `audio`, the only kind accepted) as multipart/form-data: `file`, and optionally `duration` (whole seconds; read from the file when left out) and `note` (up to 500 characters, such as "read by the author"). The file must be MP3 (`audio/mpeg`), MP4/M4A (`audio/mp4`), Ogg Vorbis (`audio/ogg`) or Ogg Opus (`audio/ogg`, `audio/opus`); its first bytes are checked, and a declared type that disagrees is refused. A version the post had is replaced at the same address. Answers the version as the post API shows it.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Length in whole seconds; read from the file when left out

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: A note, such as "read by the author"

400.description: A kind other than audio, an empty file, or a bad duration or note

409.description: Another upload of the same version was being stored

413.description: The file is larger than the limit

415.description: Not audio of an accepted type, or not the type it was sent as

404.description: No such post, or it's deleted; or, to delete, it has no such version

delete.description: Removes the post's version of this kind and its file.

404.description: No such post, or it's deleted; or, to delete, it has no such version

post.summary: Derive AI tag suggestions from unsaved editor content

400.description: Invalid input or AI unavailable

post.summary: Unhide lines of a report
post.description: Puts hidden lines of the report's excerpt back. The report's status stays.

400.description: No lines, too many, or lines not in the report's excerpt

post.summary: Purge lines of a report
post.description: Deletes lines of the report's excerpt for good, for what must not be kept. It can't be undone, so `confirm` must be true. The ids stay on the report and the action. Marks the report actioned.

400.description: Not confirmed, no lines, too many, or lines not in the report's excerpt

post.summary: Hide lines of a report
post.description: Takes lines of the report's excerpt out of the public log browser, its search and everything else that reads the log. They're kept, and an admin can unhide them. Marks the report actioned.

400.description: No lines, too many, or lines not in the report's excerpt

post.summary: Dismiss a report
post.description: Closes an open report as not abuse. The report stays readable.

400.description: The report isn't open

post.summary: Unhide log lines
post.description: Puts hidden lines back in public view.

400.description: No lines, too many, or lines that don't exist

post.summary: Hide log lines
post.description: Hides lines found in a log day rather than a report: kept, and out of public view.

400.description: No lines, too many, or lines that don't exist

post.summary: Run a console command
post.description: Submits one line, as typed at the stdin console (`aho-corasick`, `foo is bar`, `calc 2+2`), and returns at once with its correlation id: 202 means it was accepted, not that it succeeded. Its output arrives on GET /admin/console/stream as `result` events carrying that id, possibly before this answer does; a command may produce none, one or several. Open the stream first; output with no stream open is dropped. Requires an active admin, a JSON body, and the header `X-Web-Console: 1`; a request authenticated by the access-token cookie must also come from a trusted Origin (or Referer). Not retried automatically: a lost answer doesn't mean the command didn't run.

400.description: No line, or one with newlines or too long

403.description: Not an active admin, or the request's source isn't trusted

429.description: Too many commands; try again shortly

post.summary: Create a new category
Lay the Atlas out again (admin)
post.description: Recomputes the whole layout from every published post and factoid, stores it and returns it. Every place may move, so readers lose the map they've learned; new tags are placed without this.

get.summary: List taxonomy tags, categories, and aggregate union counts
List stored RSS items
List active RSS feed sources

200.description: Active RSS feed sources available to the aggregator UI

get.summary: Get a published post by slug
get.description: Returns full post detail including rendered HTML, tags, categories, and comment count. Draft posts are only visible to their author and admins.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: URL-safe slug derived from the post title

get.summary: Search published posts
get.description: Full-text search across post titles (weighted higher) and excerpts. Only published, non-deleted posts are searched. Results are ranked by relevance. Blank queries return an empty list.

get.summary: List popular published posts
get.description: Returns published posts ordered by decayed access temperature. The default page size is intentionally small for compact homepage widgets.

200.description: Paginated list of popular published posts

get.summary: Get a system page by slug
get.description: Returns a page from the _pages or _sidebar category (About, Policies, and the like) as the same ContentDetail a post has, at its undated address.

get.summary: Fetch a post version's media
get.description: The bytes of a post's version, such as its recording (`kind` `audio`). Supports `Range` requests (206 Partial Content; 416 when the range is past the end) and `If-None-Match`. The address stays the same when the version is replaced; the ETag changes. Public for published posts.

404.description: No such media, or it isn't public

416.description: The range is past the end of the file

get.summary: Fetch a post version's media, by variant
get.description: As `/media/posts/{postId}/{kind}`, for a kind with several variants.

404.description: No such media, or it isn't public

get.summary: Get one day of logs for a provenance
get.description: Every line of one UTC day, oldest first, each with its `kind`: `MESSAGE`, `JOIN`, `PART`, `QUIT`, `NICK` or `TOPIC`. `events=none` leaves out channel events (joins, parts, quits, nick changes and topics); `kinds` picks the kinds to include. Without either, every line is returned.

parameters.name: events
parameters.description: `all` (the default) for every line, `none` for what was said only, without joins, parts, quits, nick changes and topics

parameters.name: kinds
parameters.description: Only these kinds, comma-separated: `MESSAGE`, `JOIN`, `PART`, `QUIT`, `NICK`, `TOPIC` (any case). With `events`, a line must pass both.

400.description: A bad day, or an unknown `events` or `kinds` value

404.description: Provenance not found or not authorized

get.summary: Search one channel's logs
get.description: Lines in one channel whose text contains `q`, ignoring case, and written by `sender` (a nick, ignoring case), newest first. Give `q`, `sender`, or both: `sender` alone lists everything that person said there. Only a channel the caller may browse is searched; any other is a 404, as for the day logs, so a search can't reveal that a hidden channel exists. `q` is matched as written, between 3 and 200 characters. Each hit carries its `kind`. `events=none` leaves out channel events (joins, parts, quits, nick changes and topics); `kinds` picks the kinds to include. Without either, every line is returned.

parameters.name: events
parameters.description: `all` (the default) for every line, `none` for what was said only, without joins, parts, quits, nick changes and topics

parameters.name: kinds
parameters.description: Only these kinds, comma-separated: `MESSAGE`, `JOIN`, `PART`, `QUIT`, `NICK`, `TOPIC` (any case). With `events`, a line must pass both.

400.description: Neither a query nor a sender, a short or long query, a bad page or size, or an unknown `events` or `kinds` value

404.description: Provenance not found or not authorized

429.description: Too many searches; try again shortly

get.summary: List browseable log provenances for the current user
Find a channel by its readable address
get.description: The channel `/logs/{protocol}/{service}/{name}` names, among those the caller may browse: `irc/libera/primate`. An IRC name is matched as written, then with `#`, then with `##`; other protocols' channels by their names, or their ids. Its `provenanceUri` is what the day view and search take. Any other name is a 404, as a hidden channel is, so an address can't reveal one.

404.description: No such channel, or not one the caller may browse

get.summary: List active categories
Validate the current session token
Export the authenticated user's data
The Atlas: regions and places (tags) with positions, counts and pins
get.description: Laid out on the first request and stored; later requests read the stored map. A new tag is placed beside its strongest relative without moving anything; a tag no longer used is left out but keeps its place. Conditional (ETag, Last-Modified).

get.summary: One place on the Atlas, with every article and factoid found there
get.description: The tag is matched ignoring case, and an alias finds the place of the tag it means. 404 when it isn't on the map.

404.description: No place on the map has that tag

get.summary: List erased user sentinels
Export a user's data for admin review
The tag review queue
get.description: Doubtful new tags: a trailing-s pair with an existing tag (PLURAL), several words that are each a tag (MISSING_COMMA), or a near-duplicate only the AI found (AI). Open entries by default, the AI's most confident first, then newest. `openCount` is how many are open in all, for a launcher badge; `totalCount` and `totalPages` are for the status asked for, so any view can show page N of M.

400.description: A bad status, page or size

get.summary: One entry in the tag review queue
get.description: The entry, open or decided, as the queue lists it.

get.summary: Recent changes to the tag vocabulary
get.description: Aliases, splits, keeps, dismissals and stoplist changes: who and when.

get.summary: Feed tags the tag vocabulary didn't know
get.description: Waiting feed tags by default, the most carried first: counted, and created as tags once on `promoteEntries` entries across `promoteFeeds` feeds. `status=all` includes the decided ones (PROMOTED, CREATED, MAPPED, IGNORED). Feed tags that are tags, aliases or stoplisted already never wait, and aren't listed. `waitingCount` is how many wait in all, for a launcher badge; `totalCount` and `totalPages` are for the status asked for, so any view can show page N of M.

400.description: A bad status, page or size

get.summary: Export ratings and guesses as CSV
get.description: Every item with a rating or a guess: item_id, feed, title, link, published, rating, rated_by, rated_at, guess, guess_confidence, guess_reason, guess_model, guess_source, guessed_at, guess_rubric. Empty where there's no rating or no guess; guess_rubric is empty for guesses made before the rubric was recorded.

get.summary: How the model's guess agrees with the ratings
get.description: Counts per rating; agreement overall and per rating, and the confusion matrix, over the items with both a rating and a guess; and the items guessed RATES but rated DULL, and rated RATES but guessed DULL.

get.summary: The model's guesses
get.description: The model's guesses, the newest first, each with its item, the rubric it was made with (a short hash), and the editor's `rating` and whether the guess `agrees` with it (both null when the item is unrated). Unrated items are listed too; the item list (`/admin/rss/items`) never carries a guess. `label` is `all` (default), `rates`, `might` or `dull`; `rated` is `all` (default), `yes` or `no`; `feed` matches a feed's title or address and `title` a part of the item's title, as on `/rss/items`; `size` is 1 to 100. `totalCount` and `totalPages` are for the filter asked for.

400.description: A bad label or rated filter, page or size

get.summary: Export active RSS feeds as OPML
Feed items with their ratings
get.description: Stored items as `/rss/items` lists them (active feeds, newest first, `feed` and `title` filters alike), each with its `rating`, `ratedBy` and `ratedAt` (null when unrated). `rating` is `all` (default), `rates`, `might`, `dull` or `unrated`; `size` is 1 to 100. `totalCount` and `totalPages` are for the filter asked for. Never carries the model's guess.

400.description: A bad rating filter, page or size

get.summary: List pending draft posts for review
List abuse reports
get.description: Reports from the hourly review, open ones first and newest first within each; or only those in `status`. `openCount` is how many are open in all, for a launcher badge.

400.description: A bad status, page or size

get.summary: One abuse report with its excerpt
get.description: The report, the lines the review read (the person's and those around them, oldest first, hidden ones included and marked `hidden`; `flagged` raised a signal, `cited` the model pointed at), the ids of excerpt lines since purged, and every action taken on it.

get.summary: A day of a channel's log, hidden lines included
get.description: One UTC day of a channel's log as an admin reviews it: every line with its id, hidden ones included and marked `hidden`, oldest first, at most 5000. Direct conversations are never returned. `day` defaults to today.

400.description: A day that isn't YYYY-MM-DD

get.summary: Where the factoid graph could be better
get.description: Advisory, never edits (#133): factoids naming a parent that lists them without linking back; other factoids a factoid names without linking; see-also to factoids that don't exist; factoids whose one-line answer leaves parts out, or is cut off even so.

get.summary: The console's output, as server-sent events
get.description: A stream of this admin's console output, shared by all their windows. Events: `ready` (once, when the stream is registered: wait for it before submitting), `result` (data: {correlationId, status, text}; status is success, error or unhandled, and text is absent when unhandled; correlationId is null for output nobody asked for here, such as a notification or a tell from elsewhere), and heartbeat comments. Several results may share a correlation id, and none marks a command finished. The stream closes when the credential expires, the account is no longer an admin, the client falls too far behind, or after an hour; reconnect for a fresh stream. Nothing missed while disconnected is replayed. Authenticates by the access-token cookie (as a browser's EventSource sends it) or a bearer token. Single backend instance only. Behind nginx, turn off buffering for this path (the response says `X-Accel-Buffering: no`) and allow a long read timeout.

429.description: Too many streams open, or opened too often

delete.summary: Purge all content from an erased user sentinel
Delete a comment (soft by default, hard with ?hard=true)

PostVersionView.description: A version of a post: the post in another form, such as a recording of it

kind.description: What it is; `audio` is the only kind so far

variant.description: Which one of its kind, when a kind has several; null for audio

duration.description: Its length in whole seconds, when known

url.description: Where to fetch it: an absolute address on the API's own origin, stable while the version is replaced. Supports Range requests. Front ends must not rewrite it.

note.description: A note about it, such as "read by the author"

maker.description: Who made it: the uploader's display name, when known

current.description: Whether it was made from the post as it is now: false once the post's markdown has been edited since it was attached

replacedAt.description: When its content was last replaced; null if never

attribute.description: The attribute to set: text (the default), urls, tags, languages, type, seealso, see or maven

CreateContentHttpRequest.description: Request body for creating a new blog post draft

markdownSource.description: Post content in Markdown. No raw HTML allowed.
markdownSource.example: Virtual threads change the concurrency model...

tags.description: Tag names to associate with the post. Created automatically if new.

categoryIds.description: Category UUIDv7s to associate. Non-existent or deleted IDs are skipped.

summary.description: Optional manual summary text from the UI. This value is persisted as the post excerpt. If omitted or blank, the backend derives excerpt text heuristically from markdown content.

formLoadedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the form was rendered (Date.now()). Required. Submissions arriving less than 3 seconds after this timestamp are silently rejected.

TagSplitRequest.description: Split a tag into its parts

parts.description: The parts; the entry's hint tags when left out

TagChangeResult.description: What an alias, split, keep or dismiss did, or, for a dry run, what an alias or split would do

now.description: What it now stands for: the alias target, or the split's parts

factoids.description: Factoids whose tag lists were rewritten

TagReviewAliasRequest.description: Alias a queued tag to an existing one

tag.description: The existing tag the queued tag means

TagAliasRequest.description: Make a tag an alias of another

FeedTagMapRequest.description: Map a feed tag to an existing tag

FeedTagEntry.description: A feed tag the tag vocabulary didn't know, and what became of it

written.description: How feeds wrote it, a few of the forms

tag.description: The tag it became or maps to; absent while waiting or ignored

decidedBy.description: Who decided: an admin, rss (promoted), or vocabulary

examples.description: A few of the entries carrying it, newest first

FeedTagExample.description: A feed entry carrying a feed tag, as an example

FeedTagRequest.description: A feed tag to ignore or create

candidates.description: Items received in the lookback with no guess, sent to the model

calls.description: Calls made to the model, one per chunk

skipped.description: Items left without a guess: a bad, partial or missing answer

lineIds.description: Message log line ids, at most 500
Message log line ids, at most 500

confirm.description: Must be true: the admin confirmed that this can't be undone

WebConsoleCommand.description: One command line, as at the console: no prefix, no newlines.

AtlasPin.description: An article or factoid pinned around its place.

kind.description: What a pin is: an article or a factoid.

title.description: An article's title, or a factoid's selector.

createdAt.description: When a factoid was first taught.

AtlasPlaceResponse.description: A place on the map: a tag, where it is, and what's found there.

tag.description: The tag, lowercased, as /taxonomy and /posts?tag= name it.

region.description: The id of the region it's in.

articleCount.description: Published posts carrying the tag: taxonomy's tags count.

factoidCount.description: Factoids carrying the tag: taxonomy's factoidTags count.

kind.description: What is found at a place: articles only, factoids only, or both.

r.description: The mark's radius, in world units: 4 + 2.6·√(articles + factoids).

labelSize.description: The label's font size, in pixels: 10 + √size, at most 20.

minor.description: A small place (size under 3): its name shows only when zoomed in.

pins.description: The newest articles and the factoids (by name) found here, at most 8 of each, each placed around the mark. GET /atlas/places/{tag} lists them all.

AtlasRegionResponse.description: A region of the map: tags that go together.

id.description: Stable while the layout is kept; 0 is the Uncharted region.

name.description: The region's two biggest tags when laid out, joined by " · "; "Uncharted" for id 0.

r.description: How far the region reaches: its outermost place's mark, and a margin.

uncharted.description: True for the region of tags tied to nothing (id 0).

AtlasResponse.description: The Atlas: a map of the site's tags, grouped into regions by how they're used together.

regions.description: The regions, biggest first, the Uncharted region (id 0) last.

places.description: Every tag in use, each with its region and position, in region order and then biggest first. A stored tag no longer used is left out but keeps its position for when it's back.

bounds.description: The world the map spans, with a margin and room for region names.

laidOutAt.description: When the oldest place was laid out: the last full layout. Null for an empty map.

TaxonomySnapshot.description: Usage counts per taxonomy term. Terms starting with _ are never included.

tags.description: Published posts carrying each tag: approved, published by now, not deleted and not in a hidden category. Matches the totalCount of GET /posts?tag=.

aggregate.description: The union of tags, factoidTags and categories, summed per term.

categories.description: The feed's own tags for the item (RSS category, Atom category term), as written; empty when it gave none or the item was stored before tags were kept

tags.description: The BCN tags the item's feed tags map to: a tag of the same name, or an alias's tag. Stoplisted and waiting feed tags map to nothing. Feed items don't count toward tag counts or the taxonomy.

versionKinds.description: The kinds of version the post has, sorted, such as `audio` for a recording of it; empty when it has none or media is off. The versions themselves are in the post's details.
